member_import.title: Import members
member_import.intro: Bring members in from a spreadsheet, including their time-credit balances. The whole file is checked first. If anything is wrong, nothing is imported.
member_import.template_failed: The template could not be downloaded. Please try again.
member_import.file_hint: Only CSV files can be checked. In Excel, use File › Save As › "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)".
member_import.check_failed: The file could not be checked. Please try again.
member_import.check_rate_limited: You have checked a lot of files in the last minute. Wait a minute, then try again.

email.label: Email
email.rule: Required. One member per address; not already a member here.

location.label: Town
location.rule: Optional. The member's town or area. Members can add it later from their profile.

balance.label: Balance
balance.rule: Optional. Hours from the previous timebank, e.g. 12 or 12.5. Negative balances start at 0.

fix.title: How to fix it
fix.step2: Copy your columns into it under the matching headings.
fix.step3: In Excel choose File › Save As › "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)".

unknown.title: The file cannot be used
unknown.body: Something about this file stopped us checking it. Download the template, copy your columns into it, save it as "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)", and check that file.

empty_file.title: The file is empty
empty_file.body: There is nothing in this file to import.

too_large.title: The file is too large
too_large.body: Files can be up to {{max_mb}} MB. Split it into smaller files.

too_many_rows.title: Too many rows
too_many_rows.body: A file can hold up to {{max}} members. Split it into smaller files.

no_data_rows.title: No members in the file
no_data_rows.body: The file has headings but no members under them.

spreadsheet_workbook.title: This is an Excel workbook, not a CSV file
spreadsheet_workbook.body: Save it as "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)" and check that file instead.

not_text.title: This is not a spreadsheet file
not_text.body: Choose the CSV file you saved from your spreadsheet.

not_utf8.title: The file was not saved as UTF-8
not_utf8.body: Accented letters would be damaged. Save it again as "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)".

unsupported_delimiter.title: The columns are separated in a way we cannot read
unsupported_delimiter.body: Use commas or semicolons between columns, as Excel does when saving as CSV.

missing_columns.title: Columns are missing
missing_columns.body: Add these columns: {{columns}}. They can be left empty where optional.

unknown_columns.title: The file has columns that are not in the template

old_template.title: This is the old template
old_template.body: The template has changed: it now has town and balance columns and no role column.

empty_column_heading.title: A column has no heading
empty_column_heading.body: Column {{positions}} has no heading. In Excel, delete that whole column (it may look empty but still be formatted), then save again.

header_not_on_first_line.title: The headings are not on the first line
header_not_on_first_line.body: Delete the empty lines above the headings so they are on line 1, then save again.

problems.title: Nothing has been imported
problems.body: Problems found: {{problems}}. Rows with problems: {{rows}}. Fix them in your spreadsheet, then check the file again.
problems.body_file: Problems found: {{problems}}. Fix them in your spreadsheet, then check the file again.
problems.more: …and {{more}} more. Download the list to see them all.
problems.download_corrected: Download a corrected file without the people who are already members
problems.corrected_note: The corrected file still contains the other problems listed here.

problem.control_characters: {{column}} contains hidden control characters. Retype it.
problem.invalid_encoding: {{column}} contains characters that could not be read. Retype it, then save the file as "CSV UTF-8".
problem.invalid_email: This is not a valid email address. If the address has accented letters in its domain, use its plain (ASCII) form.
problem.example_address: This is the example row from a template. Delete it.
problem.disposable_email: Throwaway email addresses are not accepted.
problem.invalid_phone: This is not a valid phone number. Use international format, e.g. +1 555 123 4567.
problem.invalid_number: This is not a number. Use digits only, like 12 or 12.5 — no units or thousands separators.
problem.balance_too_large: Balances can be up to {{max}} hours.
problem.total_balance_too_large: Together, the balances in this file come to more than {{max}} hours. Check that the balance column is in hours and not another unit.
problem.nothing_left_to_import: Every member in this file has already been imported from it. There is nothing left to import.
problem.wrong_cell_count: This row has {{found}} cells; the headings have {{expected}}.
problem.duplicate_in_file: This email is also on row {{first_row}}.
problem.already_member: This person is already a member of this community.
problem.already_member_unmatched: An existing member's email differs from an email in this file only by accents or spacing. Check the emails in this file against your existing members.

warning.negative_balance_zeroed: a balance of {{original}} hours will start at 0.
warning.unknown: this row will be imported with a changed value.

ready.title: Every row passed the check
ready.without_town: Without a town: {{n}} (they can add it from their profile)
ready.negatives: Negative balances that will start at 0: {{n}}
ready.already_imported: Already imported from this same file earlier, so skipped: {{n}}
ready.identity_attest: I have checked each person's identity myself
ready.identity_help: Your community requires an identity check. If you leave this unticked, these members will wait for that check before they can sign in.
ready.send_invitations: Email each new member a link to set their password
ready.send_invitations_help: Emails go out in the background, about one a second ({{duration}} for this file). The link lasts 7 days.
ready.invitations_held_note: Members waiting for an identity check are not emailed now — invite them from the member list once they are approved.

running.title: Importing members
running.keep_open: Keep this window open until the import finishes.

done.held: These members are waiting for your community's identity check before they can sign in.
done.download_zeroed: Download the list of members whose balance started at 0
done.admission_incomplete_one: {{countFormatted}} member was created but their identity step did not complete (rows {{rows}}). Open them from the member list and resend their identity check, or contact support.
done.admission_incomplete_other: {{countFormatted}} members were created but their identity step did not complete (rows {{rows}}). Open each one from the member list and resend their identity check, or contact support.
done.invitations_queued_one: {{countFormatted}} welcome email is queued and will go out over {{duration}}.
done.invitations_queued_other: {{countFormatted}} welcome emails are queued and will go out over {{duration}}.

undo.confirm: Remove the members this import created? Members who have already signed in or taken part in any exchange are kept.
undo.done: Import undone. Removed: {{removed}}. Kept because they have already used their account: {{kept}}.
undo.failed: The import could not be undone. Try again, or contact support.
undo.busy: The import is still running. Stop it first, then undo it.
undo.working: Removing members… {{removed}} removed so far. Keep this window open.

stopped.title: The import stopped. Members imported: {{created}} of {{total}}.
stopped.download_remaining: Download the rows that were not imported
stopped.next_step: Fix the cause if there is one, then check the downloaded file to import the rest.
stopped.all_processed: Every row in the file was processed, so there is nothing left to download. The member list shows who was imported.

stop.email_now_taken: Row {{row}}: someone with this email joined while the import was running.
stop.row_changed: Row {{row}} no longer passes the check.
stop.write_failed: Row {{row}} could not be saved. Nothing of that row was saved.

failed.title: The connection to the server was lost
failed.body: Members imported so far are saved. Download the rows that were not imported and check that file to continue.
failed.not_found: This import has expired or was replaced by a newer check. Members imported so far are saved. Download the rows that were not imported and check that file to continue.
failed.out_of_order: This import continued in another window. Members imported so far are saved. Download the rows that were not imported and check that file to continue.
